summary_1line: The sage recounts the miraculous birth and world-conquering deeds of King Mandhata, born from King Yuvanaswa after he accidentally drank consecrated water.

image_candidates.scene_text: After a hundred years, a radiant child bursts from King Yuvanaswa’s left side while astonished sages look on.
The thirsty King Yuvanaswa in a dark hermitage drinks from a sacred jar left beside the sleeping sages.
Indra places his forefinger in the newborn child’s mouth as the gathered gods watch and name him Mandhata.
